changelog:
Initial release of filtrix-video-gen skill.

- Enables video generation via Filtrix Remote MCP API.
- Supports text-to-video and image-to-video modes.
- Includes tools for polling video task status and downloading completed videos.
- Requires MCP API key for authentication.
- Provides CLI examples and guides for typical workflows.
